meta.name: red-team
meta.description: Stress-test a plan, brief or delivery claim against evidence and plausible failure modes. Use when the user asks for a red team or preparation for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把重要方案、简报或交付说法拿来压力测试,提前挑出站不住脚的地方
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果即将为一个影响重大的决定拍板,想先找出方案里的薄弱点。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan, brief, or delivery claim before a big decision.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to make a consequential decision and need the weak spots found first.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对照证据和可能的失败模式,对你的计划、简报或交付声明做压力测试,指出站不住的地方。它先读任务背景契约与方法文档,按需再加载其他参考,不新建工程目录。
howto.when: 当你要求做红队演练,或为一项重大决策做准备时触发。若由 @fde 调用,会沿用其当前的净化信息包与范围,不重走设置和提问。

say.text: 帮我对这份上线计划做一次红队演练
say.note: 会对照证据和失败模式逐条挑问题

say.text: 这个交付声明有哪些可能的失败模式?
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收

say.text: 为明天的重大决策做红队准备
say.note: 缺的信息会如实标为未知,不编造

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stress-tests your plan, brief or delivery claim against evidence and plausible failure modes, flagging what doesn't hold up. It first reads the task-context contract and method, loading more references only as needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a red team, or when preparing for a consequential decision. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Red-team this launch plan for me
say_en.note: Tests it against evidence and failure modes

say_en.text: What are the plausible failure modes of this delivery claim?
Prep a red team for tomorrow's big decision
